title: On dg properads of pre-CY algebras
summary: We present new small models for the dg properads that govern pre-CY algebras: one for general pre-CY algebras and one for pre-CY algebras without curvature terms. These small models have only four and, respectively, three generators with valencies $\leq 4$ (in contrast to the original properads which have infinitely many generators with arbitrarily large valencies). We prove that the valency upper bound $4$ is sharp.
